title: OPH-FEP-Synergetics: executable correspondences, obstructions and complementarities across Observer Patch Holography, the Free Energy Principle, and Fuller's Synergetics
description: An executable correspondence battery: every three-way identification across Observer Patch Holography (OPH), the Free Energy Principle (FEP), and Fuller's Synergetics is registered as a correspondence with a pairwise scope and an executable probe. Forty-two probes pass or fail, and the failing direction is reported as a result rather than hidden as a gap. The suite covers the carrier's exact spectrum and shell arithmetic, the native repair law's conservation and closed-form energy identity over all 4680 shell transitions, patch agreement as a sheaf condition whose Laplacian equals the carrier Laplacian, the linear-Gaussian free-energy dictionary with its exact-on-domain identification, fifteen obstructions exhibited as executable failures, and the quadray/IVM geometry with exact rational tetravolumes.
